category_title: Students with emotional and behavioural disabilities transitioning to mainstream vocational settings
scenario_title: Academic task resistance and questioning relevance
minimal_context: Ian is in class with his peers and has been assigned a literacy worksheet to complete.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Ian, here is your literacy worksheet for today. Please read the first passage and start answering the questions.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Leaves the worksheet untouched on the desk, staring at the computer screen instead of starting the assignment)

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It has been five minutes, Ian. You need to begin the worksheet now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Why do I even have to do this? What is the relevance of this primary school reading stuff? I should be working towards getting my driver's licence, not this.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: This is the assigned school work for today's lesson. Please just focus and get it done.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Pushes the worksheet off the desk and starts drumming loudly on the table) I'm not doing it! It's completely irrelevant! (Calls out loudly across the room to his peers) Hey, you guys aren't actually doing this garbage, are you?
